release_order: 1. If *handle is non-null, call finalize helper 0x5163460 with (stack status record, handle); free the record message pointer if non-null. The code/sub fields are discarded.
2. Release the handle's +0x48 polymorphic member (below). This step runs even when *handle is null.
3. Free the handle's +0x50 array with operator delete[] when non-null. This step runs even when *handle is null.
4. inner = *handle; if null, return (canary-checked epilogue). The handle shell is not freed.
5. Call status helper 0x52b2550 with (stack status record, inner); free the record message pointer if non-null. The rest of the result is discarded.
6. If inner+0xc8 is non-null, call its second virtual (vtable +0x8); result ignored.
7. Walk the vector at inner+0xb0 (begin) .. inner+0xb8 (end), stride 0x10; run the shared-release protocol on each element's +0x8 pointer.
8. Free the vector backing array with sized delete (size = inner+0xc0 minus inner+0xb0) when inner+0xb0 is non-null.
9. Free inner+0x48 with operator delete[] when non-null.
11. Run the shared-release protocol on inner+0x28.
12. Free the inner string at +0 (pointer +0, capacity-or-inline-buffer +0x10): skipped when the pointer equals the address of the +0x10 slot, else sized delete with size = value at +0x10 plus 1.
13. Sized delete of the inner object itself, 0xe0 bytes.
